step_by_step_reasoning:
1. Identify external actors at the bottom: UserConsumerMobile and UserConsumerWeb using mobile/web interfaces.
2. Identify primary ingestion layer: EC2 (legacy app hosting) connected to CouchBase and Aurora for backend persistent storage.
3. Identify task creation and synchronization components: EC2 pushes task creation to DynamoDB. AppSync distributes tasks to mobile and web clients.
4. Identify asynchronous/batch processing: Fargate and RedShift process analytics and task priority updates, sending updates to DynamoDB.
5. Identify helper compute functions: Two Lambda functions handle complex orchestration flows (one bridging AppSync to EC2, another bridging AppSync to DynamoDB).
